policy_presence.summary: Formal Code (2025), SGS and teaching guidance address AI.

coursework.summary: Marked work follows instructor permission; general learning-aid use is typically acceptable.

exams.summary: Unauthorized aids prohibited under Code s.4(b).

ai_disclosure.summary: Cite AI content that needs citation; learning-aid use usually not disclosed; doctoral theses must describe AI use.

privacy_data_entry.summary: Data level checks; AI Kitchen to Level 3 (Model Comparison Level 2); no unapproved uploads of course materials.

academic_integrity.summary: Code offences incl. concocted references; staged procedure; detectors not supported.

approved_tools.summary: Copilot Chat and Cogniti for students; licensed tools mainly for staff/faculty; AIK services coming soon.

named_ai_services.summary: AI Kitchen named services with audience, cost and seat conditions.

teaching_guidance.summary: Syllabus statements recommended; AI detectors not supported.

research_guidance.summary: Doctoral thesis AI use requires prior approval; other milestones: documented approval recommended.

security_procurement.summary: PIA required for unvetted tools collecting personal information; opt-out alternatives.
